item.title: Megi Maeuntang at Uiseong Maneul Hwangto Megi, Bucheon
item.description: Spicy catfish stew at Uiseong Maneul Hwangto Megi in Jakdong, Bucheon. Freshwater shrimp make the broth, and a block of ramyeon noodles goes in as a matter of course.

item.title: Eating at Home in Seoul — A Summer of Homesul and Homebap
item.description: A summer of eating at home in Seoul: Kahlúa milk with spicy jjukkumi, delivered sora-muchim stretched with hand-boiled somyeon, Deungchon shabu-shabu broth with supermarket beef, samgyeopsal buried in minari, and yukhoe with homemade malatang. Including what worked and what did not.

item.title: Baekban — A Proper Korean Set Meal in Paju
item.description: Lunch at Bapsarang, a countryside diner in Paju (north of Seoul), the kind of place Koreans call a baekban-jip (백반집).

item.title: Kkot-Samgyeop (Flower Pork Belly) — Daebit Sikdang, Gaebong-dong
item.description: Korean BBQ night at Daebit Sikdang near home. Their thing is kkot-samgyeop (꽃삼겹, 'flower pork belly') grilled on a dome-shaped stone pan.

item.title: Dakjang Maekju — My Neighborhood Chicken & Beer Pub
item.description: My local pub, Dakjang Maekju in Gaebong-dong — walking distance from home, which in Korea is a blessing.

item.title: Hanchi Mulhoe & Octopus Rice Bowl — Yoonsikdang, Geoje
item.description: Lunch on Geoje Island at a place called Yoonsikdang. We ordered hanchi mulhoe and a rock-octopus rice bowl.

item.title: Dongtae-tang Breakfast on Geoje Island
item.description: Day two on Geoje Island. Breakfast at the pollack-stew place right in front of our lodging.

item.title: Milmyeon on Geoje Island — Woomyeonga
item.description: Found a great noodle place on Geoje Island (south coast of Korea) called Woomyeonga. This one was seriously good.

item.title: Gopchang Jeongol — Korean Intestine Hot Pot in Gaebong-dong
item.description: Tonight's anju (안주 — food you eat while drinking) is gopchang jeongol, at my regular place Yeokjeon Sundae-guk in Gaebong-dong, Seoul.
